Port of Catalogan. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of
Catbalogan situated in Barangay Poblacion, Catbalogan City, Province of Samar, is
hereby delineated and established, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being S. 81 deg. 41' W., 64.88 m.
from SMR-3065, PRS-92, Catbalogan City, Samar, thence:

Containing a total area of FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY THOUSAND ONE
HUNDRED FORTY-EIGHT (480,148) SQUARE METERS, more or less.

PPA Jurisdiction. The Catbalogan Port Zone, as delineated, is
hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PA, which shall, consistent
with the regional industrial plans of the government, implement a program for the proper
zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended
or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th of
